en: Everyone looked unhappy about it, but this should calm things down a little beneath the castle.{w}
note: [JP] -> 'beneath the castle', matching the 'things underground' lines in slice 059. Subject of [JP] (the defeated contestants) kept as 'everyone'.

en: The Referee is cleaning up after the Spirit Tournament.{w}
"There's something so wistful about the end of a festival, isn't there..."{w}
"The age of the Fire Elemental is comiiing!!"{w}
"Guess the age of the Fire Elemental never came..."{w}
"We're on top form this term!{w}We'll send Ifrit and Phoenix flying!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'we' (the Fire Elemental's side). [JP] -> 'send flying', as in the battle narration 3041.

en: "I'll let that guy have this Spirit Tournament."{w}
note: [JP] = presumably the Fire Elemental who competes; left as 'that guy' (no gender implied beyond the casual register).

en: "Heh. The next Spirit Tournament, that's when I get my shot!!"{w}

"We Fire Elementals are done with our long years of burning low.
Now is the time to rise up!{w}Onward, comrades!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'burning low' (keeps the fire pun: [JP] = waning). [JP] -> 'comrades' to fit the 'flame of revolution' line 3132.

en: The Fire Elemental headed for the ring.{w}
"Sizzle, sizzle, sizzle...{w}And here I was, burning so nicely...{w}Where has the flame of revolution gone..."{w}
note: [JP] = smouldering sound, rendered 'Sizzle'.

en: "BLAAASTERRR!{w}The fire kin's Spirit Tournament!{w}It's ours for the takiiing!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'Buster/Blaster' shout; matches the Ifrit's Fire/Bomber/Number One shouts.

en: "...Daaamn iiit!{w}If I'd been out there, this never would've happened..."{w}
"FIIIRE!!{w}Our boss is gonna wiiin, no matter what!!"{w}
"We lost, but... it was a fun tournament, right?{w}Come back and hang out again sometime!!"{w}
"BOMBERRR!!{w}Burn, burn, burn it all dooown!!{w}Go get 'eeem! Our BOOOSS!!"{w}
"Hahh... hahh...{w}W-while I wuz wadchin'...{w}I cheered so hard, by throad burned oud..."{w}
note: Source voices every syllable (hoarse voice); rendered with nasal/hoarse spelling. Subject 'I' restored.

en:
"NUMBER ONE!!{w}With these well-honed flames, I'll turn that Phoenix Queen
into roast chicken! Let's go, you lot!!"{w}
note: [JP] (yakitori) -> 'roast chicken'. [JP] -> 'you lot' (rough address to his own crew).

en: Ifrit headed for the ring.{w}
"You got past me to become Number One!{w}Till we meet again, I'm leaving Number One in your hands!{w}Lose to anybody, and you'll answer to me!!"{w}
note: Said to the party (the winners).

en: "Our Queen is the previous champion.{w}There's no way she'll lose this term either."{w}
note: Queen = the Phoenix Queen (female per glossary).

en: "...Hmph, don't get too full of yourselves, got it?{w}The Queen will rise back to the throne!{w}That's right, because she's a phoenix, the bird that never dies!!"{w}
note: [JP] (lit. 'undying bird', the Japanese word for phoenix) unpacked so the pun survives.

en: "There's nobody who can beat Her Majesty, I'm tellin' ya!{w}Fire Elemental, Ifrit, you oughta just give up already!!"{w}
note: [JP] -> 'Her Majesty' (this Phoenix's address form) vs [JP] 'the Queen' in 3152/3154.

en: "A walk-on entry or whatever, that's not fair!{w}What the heck, geez{w}Aaargh, geeeez!!"{w}
note: Source has no closing punctuation on the middle line; kept bare.

en:
"Her Majesty, y'know, has been winning and winning
ever since I was a kid, all the waaay!!"{w}
"Her Majesty lost...{w}But she'll win next time, I just know it!{w}And someday, I'll be just like Her Majesty too..."{w}

"Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho!!{w}The rabble may be making a fuss, but riffraff are riffraff in the end.{w}There is simply no way they could ever match the likes of me!"{w}{p}"Now then, I suppose it is about time I entered the venue.{w}Without me, there would be no splendor at all, after all.{w}Oh-ho-ho-ho-ho-ho!!"{w}
note: [JP] (affected posh 'I') -> 'the likes of me'; [JP] kept as prim, formal English.

en: The Phoenix Queen headed for the ring.{w}
"To think I would end up handing the championship to you.{w}Everyone was so worked up at this term's tournament, weren't they?{w}...I do hope nothing catastrophic is about to happen."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'something catastrophic' (a great upheaval); echoes the Referee's Contrachio remark in 3032.

en: Nishimikado
note: Glossary form.

en:
"Adventurers, eh? What a coincidence, meeting you in a place like this!{w}Did you know?
This is the summit of the Churos Highlands: the keep."{w}{p}"Thanks to my war banner,
these highlands are kept under guard.{w}You may adventure in peace... What?"{w}{p}"You want to change this banner?{w}What foolishness is this? Even if it were changed,
which banner would you even put up...?"{w}{p}"...Don't tell me.{w}That one.{w}THAT banner!?"{w}{p}"Hmmm...{w}I have no intention of rejecting diversity out of hand.{w}But... won't you reconsider?"{w}{p}"No, is it?{w}That's the one you want?{w}...Hmmm... ...this is a predicament."{w}{p}"Very well.{w}If you insist that much, we shall hold the handover ritual.{w}Did you think you could raise the guardian banner for nothing?"{w}{p}"The handover ritual is this: holding the banner
you mean to raise next, you must go once around
this place counterclockwise within the set time."{w}{p}"Have you been looking closely at your map?{w}You'll see 'X' marks lined up along a single path.{w}That is the course."{w}{p}"I shall now start the clock,
and you must make one lap and return before it reaches 0."{w}{p}"However, no detours along the way,
and no teleporting by spell or the like.{w}Steel yourselves and go to it."{w}
note: [JP] = castle keep (the summit spot); [JP] -> 'kept under guard' / 'guardian banner'. [JP] = 'war banner', [JP] = 'banner' throughout (slice 017 called Rondelgius' item 'this flag'; the lead may align flag/banner). 'THAT banner' = Rondelgius' flag. [JP] -> 'the handover ritual'. [JP] -> 'counterclockwise'. Nishimikado's gender is unknown: no pronoun used.

en: Undertake the ritual?
"Very well, here we go...{w}Ready...{w}Begin!!"{w}
"Oh, have you, then!{w}It helps me a great deal that you've reconsidered!!"{w}
note: Reply to the party declining the ritual.

en: "What, you made it back in time!?{w}Hmmm, I have no choice but to acknowledge this."{w}

"Very well! In place of my war banner,
raise that banner of yours!!"{w}
note: Source writes [JP] for [JP]; read as 'in place of'.

en:
You pulled up Nishimikado's banner
and drove Rondelgius's banner into the ground.{w}The air all around grew taut, and then...{w}
"Wh-what is this presence...!?{w}Is it coming from beneath us!?"{w}
"Time's up!!"{w}
note: [JP] = the timer ran out.

en:
"Ha ha ha! What's the matter, is that all you've got?{w}Too bad, but with a showing like that,
I can't let you change the guardian banner!"{w}
"Wh-what do you think you're doing!?{w}Intruders! Guards, to me! Guaaards!!"{w}
note: [JP] = period-drama call for the guard; rendered as a call for guards. Party is plural: 'Intruders'.

en: You sent Nishimikado flying.{w}
note: Same verb as 3041 'You sent them all flying'.

en: "Impossible... to think I'd yield it in such a way.{w}No -- a defeated general has no right to talk tactics.{w}I shall acknowledge the diversity of rituals!"{w}
note: [JP] (proverb) -> 'a defeated general has no right to talk tactics'.

en: "Train harder, and come back!!"{w}

"What, you made it back in time!?{w}Hmmm, I have no choice but to acknowledge this."{w}{p}"...No, wait, wait, wait!{w}You lot, what happened to that pathetic banner?{w}You're not even carrying it, are you?"{w}{p}"Why did you throw it away?{w}No matter what others may think, if that banner is what you like,
you can raise it with your head held high, you know?"{w}{p}"...Well, I would hate it, mind you."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'that pathetic banner' (Rondelgius' flag). Branch where the party ran the lap without the flag.
Shorter repeat greeting (no [JP] here).

en: "What, you actually quelled that presence!?{w}Nnnngh...{w}I suppose I have no choice but to acknowledge this..."{w}
"I...{w}What a terrible thing I have done..."{w}
note: Likely the line after the swap awakened the presence; 'I' kept as the first fragment per the source split.

en: "Th-this is it... our royal tomb...{w}It sure feels like something's gonna pop out..."{w}{p}"Hey, um, you guys...{w}Go... on ahead..."{w}
"Oh, so you've come at long last."{w}
"HYAAAAAAH!?{w}I-it's heeere! A ghooost!!"{w}
"So you're the one they call Montana?"{w}
"H-how do you know my name!?"{w}

"What a silly child you are.{w}It's your ancestors' tomb,
so of course there's folk here who know you."{w}
note: Speaker is Ubogenya (identified two rows later).

en: "Huh?{w}Th-that voice, I've heard it before...{w}Could it be... that old hag Ubogenya!?"{w}
note: [JP] kept rude-affectionate: 'old hag' (not softened to 'Granny').

en: Ubogenya
note: Glossary form.

en: "Long time no see! You been keepin' well?"{w}
Bohinyob
note: Glossary form.

en:
"And I'm Bohinyob, the one who came
even a generation before Ubogenya."{w}
note: [JP] = the head one generation before Ubogenya.

en: "Never heard of you."{w}
"Well, I was already dead by the time you were born."{w}
Babis
note: Glossary form.

en:
"And I am Bohinyob's drinking buddy!!
The kobold samurai, Babis, at your service!{w}'Tis only the back of the blade, I assure you!!"{w}
note: [JP] (striking with the blunt back of a sword) -> 'the back of the blade'; it pays off in slice 061 (2830: no back of the blade on a double-edged sword). [JP] -> archaic formal English.

en: "Kobolds have nothing to do with this!{w}And what do you mean, drinking buddy!?"{w}
"Let us not be so stiff about it!"{w}

"With us, it's been the rule since the old days
that nobody gets to inherit the throne easily, see."{w}
note: Accuracy: tsugenu you ni natte te = it is set up so one cannot simply succeed to the throne (a succession rule, which Montana answers with the bungee); draft read as our kind being unable to take the throne.

en: "Oh, you mean the bungee, right?{w}I did it, all proper!"{w}
note: The new king's bungee jump (slices 048/049).

en: "Huh? Bungee?{w}That's nothing but a sideshow."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'sideshow' (entertainment, not the real test).

en: "It IS!?"{w}

"The chief of Baroque Fort, y'see,
has an important duty in this land."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'chief' (the ruler of Baroque Fort).

en: "An important duty? What's that?"{w}
"Dunno."{w}
"'Dunno'!?"{w}
note: [JP]: Montana echoes the answer in disbelief.

en: "I dunno either, but it's important, apparently."{w}
note: Subject 'I' restored for Ubogenya.

en:
"Come to think of it, back when I was alive,
I was told, 'Ask the Elf King for the details,' or some such."{w}
note: [JP] -> 'the Elf King' (not in glossary; generic title).

en:
"Well, I dunno what it's for, but for now,
you've got to test your strength against your forebears and win."{w}
note: [JP] here = the previous heads (plural, per 2804 'all of us').

en:
"We're fighting?{w}Ha ha, no way I'd lose,
not with all these guys on my side..."{w}
note: [JP] = Montana counts the party on his side; next row (slice 061) undercuts it.
